import datetime,difflib,hashlib,json,pathlib
B=pathlib.Path('/workspace/scratch/actual-source-regular-local-collar-construct');S=B/'RegularLocalCollarControls.lean';cp=B/'FIRST_ID_CACHE.json';cache=json.loads(cp.read_text())
H=B/'history/ordinary-fix001';H.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=False)
changes=[]
old=S.read_text();new=old
for a,b in [["    · simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_zero, Real.norm_eq_abs] using ha","    · simpa using ha"],["    · simpa only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Real.norm_eq_abs] using hε","    · simpa using hε"],["    · simp only [Matrix.cons_val_one, Real.norm_eq_abs]\n      rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < ρ / 2)]\n      linarith","    · have hh : |ρ / 2| < ρ := by\n        rw [abs_of_pos (by positivity : 0 < ρ / 2)]\n        linarith\n      simpa using hh"]]:
 assert new.count(a)==1;new=new.replace(a,b)
changes.append((S,old,new))
C=B/'runner/classify_inventory.py';before=C.read_text();a="props={'FixedCutChecks','FixtureOutput','omittedNonzeroDerivativeMutation'}";assert before.count(a)==1
changes.append((C,before,before.replace(a,"props={'FixedCutChecks','FixtureOutput','InversePoint','FixedCases','PositiveAt','omittedNonzeroDerivativeMutation'}")))
patch=[]
for path,before,after in changes:
 orig=H/(path.name+'.ORIGINAL');orig.write_text(before);prior=cache[str(path)];st=orig.stat();cache[str(orig)]={**prior,'path':str(orig),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'origin':'Known exact prior source/script ID REUSED; no hash','copied_from':str(path)}
 path.write_text(after);patch.extend(difflib.unified_diff(before.splitlines(keepends=True),after.splitlines(keepends=True),fromfile='history/ordinary-fix001/'+path.name+'.ORIGINAL',tofile=str(path.relative_to(B))))
p=B/'ORDINARY_FIX001_FULL.patch';p.write_text(''.join(patch));st=p.stat();cache[str(p)]={'path':str(p),'bytes':st.st_size,'sha256':hashlib.sha256(p.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),'marker':[st.st_size,st.st_mtime_ns],'first_observed_utc':datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc).isoformat(),'origin':'FIRST actual ordinary/new-classification amendment patch identity, once'}
cp.write_text(json.dumps(cache,indent=2)+'\n')
print(json.dumps({'scope':'Only controls002 finite-vector membership simplifications; classify NEW ordinary privateProp names correctly without rerunning production','full_patch':str(p)}))
